scripts.dev:docs: concurrently -k -n VITE,CDN,DOCS -c cyan,yellow,green "pnpm --prefix packages/superdoc run dev" "pnpm --prefix packages/superdoc run watch:cdn" "pnpm --filter @superdoc/docs run dev"
scripts.build:clean: pnpm run clean:packages && pnpm run build:superdoc && pnpm run type-check:force
scripts.reset: pnpm run clean:packages && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'package-lock.json' -type f -delete && pnpm install
scripts.lint: vp lint packages shared scripts apps/cli apps/mcp apps/vscode-ext
scripts.lint:fix: vp lint --fix packages shared scripts apps/cli apps/mcp apps/vscode-ext
scripts.pack: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run pack:es
scripts.release: pnpm run type-check && pnpm --prefix packages/superdoc exec semantic-release
scripts.prepare: if [ -z "$CI" ] && command -v vp >/dev/null 2>&1; then vp config --no-agent; fi
scripts.check:all: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run test
scripts.check:examples: node --test scripts/__tests__/check-examples.test.mjs && node scripts/check-examples.mjs && pnpm --recursive --filter './examples/*' run typecheck && pnpm --recursive --filter './examples/*' run test
scripts.update-preset-geometry: ROOT=$(pwd) && cd ../superdoc-devtools/preset-geometry && pnpm run build && cp ./dist/index.js ./dist/index.js.map ./dist/index.d.ts "$ROOT/packages/preset-geometry/"
scripts.docapi:sync:check: pnpm run generate:docapi && pnpm run check:public:docapi
scripts.check:release-scripts: node --test scripts/__tests__/npm-registry.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/npm-mirror-publish.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/publish-superdoc-policy.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/audit-publish-artifact.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/engine-prepared-input.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/engine-native-runtime.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/superdoc-build-timing.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/ci-docx-engine-artifact.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/ci-superdoc-build-artifact.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/pack-superdoc.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/local-publish.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/publish-fonts-baseline.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/fonts-release-scope.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/resume-fonts-release.test.mjs && pnpm --filter superdoc run smoke:v2-resolver
scripts.check:public: pnpm run check:public:superdoc && pnpm run check:public:docapi
